long.scope: Full qualification warmed-kernel salted long prompts, separate from rapid screen cohort.

generation.scope: Seven full-answer streaming companions. Original nonstream quality cohort remains the historical comparison. Post-first-output rate uses (completion_tokens-1)/(HTTP time-TTFT), matching the recorded Tony convention. It includes transport and finalization; speculative chunks can contain multiple tokens. This is not GPU-only decode timing. A transport pass is not a functional quality pass.

summary.backend_rate_note: Service-wide counter, includes unfinished streams and any health probes; snapshot interval includes small launch/drain overhead, not a pure decode rate.
